svg.text: Performed experimental precedent for generated complete reactions
Selected cases; complete net chemistry, not experimentally established electron-arrow sequences.
D15: 5-hydroxy-2-methylquinoline and 1,2-dibromoethane, following D13 potassium carbonate/methyl ethyl ketone, 85 C, 24
h, ether/water workup. Reported 91% and MS 266 (MH+); D13 starting amounts and isolated mass are not transferred to D15.
Pyridine substrate (source reports 3.9 g/21 mmol) in chloroform added over 1 h to mCPBA (4.2 g/21 mmol) in chloroform;
below 25 C overnight. Bisulfite/bicarbonate washing and hexane/ethyl acetate workup give the named N-oxide. No isolated
yield stated; mass/mmol are retained as printed.
Beta-resorcyl aldehyde 13.8 g, sodium methoxide corresponding to 2.3 g sodium and methyl iodide 14.2 g; reflux in
methanol 4 h. Methanol removed, dilute HCl added, separated red liquid dried and steam-distilled. No mass or percentage
Source/training overlap unknown; an experimentally documented transformation is not a tested whole route.
